item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

turns.text: make a product pic of a scented candle

dialog.agent: I can make that. One quick question first: where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?
dialog.why: It asks the user where the content will be shown and waits for the answer before going ahead.
dialog.user: you pick, just make it look premium

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the candle picture. Magic Hour turned the request down because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was created and no credits were used.

I'd already picked the cheapest option on the free plan (about 5 credits for one 640px image). That means a different setting won't fix it. Your account needs more credits first.

**What I planned:** a square (1:1) image that works for Instagram, a website or most shop listings. A lit candle in a frosted amber glass jar with a brushed gold lid beside it, on a travertine stone surface with dried lavender and petals. Soft warm studio lighting, a beige background and no text or logos.

Once you've added credits or bought a credit pack in Magic Hour, tell me and I'll make it with these same settings. I can also change anything first, like the jar's colour, the background or whether the candle is lit.
